unit: MIT Initiative on the Digital Economy research groups

labs.pi_title: Research Group Lead; Research Affiliate and Professor at the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business
labs.research_summary: Uses cognitive science and digital field experiments to learn why people believe and share false content online and to test anti-misinformation interventions, partly with tech companies.
labs.notes: Listed among the Research Groups on the IDE research page. The group page says David Rand leads it; the IDE pages give his title as a research affiliate and Cornell professor. Depth pass 2026-11-22: Null: the Misinformation & Fake News group page names David Rand as its lead but lists only paper co-authors, not a group roster; it describes him as a research affiliate and a professor at Cornell, and its newest listed paper is from Nov 2024. The worklist's people link (Sinan Aral's profile) was ignored.

labs.pi_title: Research Group Lead; Director, MIT IDE; Professor, MIT Sloan School of Management
labs.research_summary: Studies how generative and decentralizing technologies such as GenAI and blockchain change power, scale and productivity, a wider remit than its earlier Web3 focus.
labs.notes: Listed among the Research Groups on the IDE research page. The group page says it is led by IDE Director Sinan Aral. The site menu links the same group name to https://ide.mit.edu/research-group/genai/; the research page body links the address recorded here, which is the one read. Depth pass 2026-11-22: Null: the Applied AI group page says it is led by IDE Director Sinan Aral but lists only co-authors of its papers (several at other universities), with no group roster; the worklist's people link (Aral's own profile) was not used for a count.

labs.pi_title: Research Group Lead; Research Scientist and Senior Lecturer, MIT Sloan School of Management
labs.research_summary: Studies human-AI interaction with behavioral science methods, including when people trust algorithms, how to reduce algorithmic bias and how people and AI can learn from each other.
labs.notes: Listed among the Research Groups on the IDE research page. The group page says Renée Richardson Gosline leads it. Depth pass 2026-11-22: Null: the Human-First AI group page names Renée Richardson Gosline as lead but lists only paper co-authors, no group roster, and its newest listed work is from 2023. The worklist's people link (Sinan Aral's profile) was ignored.

notes: The IDE itself is target mit-ide and gets no entry here. The research page lists nine research groups, all recorded, with no leads or blurbs; group names follow the research page body, which differs slightly from the site menu (noted per entry). Fetched three group pages (Applied AI, Misinformation & Fake News, Human-First AI) to find leads; the other six are recorded without a lead. The Research Team page tags Acquisti, Aral, Eckles, Gosline and Horton as Research Group Leaders but does not say which group each leads, and that page is cut off by a pager, so it was not used to assign leads. Member counts were not taken, as instructed. Analytics Lab (A-Lab) and GenAI Lab are listed under Education, not research, and are not recorded. Named on the pages but given no entry, because no lead or site of their own is shown (6): AI in Financial Markets and Decision-Making; AI, Marketplaces and Labor Markets; Artificial Intelligence, Quantum and Beyond; Data, Markets and Privacy; New Data and Analytics; Technology-Driven Organizations and Digital Culture.
